facts.value: As part of your program at the Department of Economics, you can take certain modules at other departments, known as import modules from other departments, including optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between the departments.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: For the study programs of the Department of Economics, an overview is compiled showing which import modules you can register for at other departments and how you can incorporate these import modules into your program at the Department of Economics.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: Furthermore, you cannot incorporate any other modules from other departments into your program at the Department of Economics and you cannot earn any different credit points (CP).
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance
